limitations: Initial creation used Qwen reasoning with a 4096-token output limit. Qwen edit attempts were truncated, timed out and stopped after 535 seconds. Gemma4 without reasoning repeated a syntax error; the final repair enabled reasoning.
A separate retry started an older shared cloud binary and rejected mod_sdk before generation. The final test used a copied executable built from the isolated branch.
The disposable test probe arranges players, selects an existing wand and fixes daylight; actual use arrives as controller frames.
Passing this mechanic does not establish reliability for arbitrary generated gameplay.
The first program persists a clock-based cooldown; this can delay use after restart. Source undo restores that code too.
The SDK execution boundary is experimental and has not received an independent security audit.
